title: 第25章 哪吒朕已是给足了你颜面第26章 既然如今是朕的侍女总窝在别人怀里像什么样子
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 哪吒胸口猛地起伏，嘴唇动了动，却一时语塞————
他确实怕。
怕江盼被查时，自己那“离了她便浑身灼痛、灵力暴走”
的怪病被扯出来，
更怕这事传到玉帝耳朵里，再动用那玲珑宝塔将他死死压住，连半分自由都不剩。
可他不能露怯。
哪吒忽而低笑一声，心底那股狠劲又烧了起来，语气满是威慑：“我的事，轮不到你这石缝里蹦出来的野猴多嘴！”
“倒是你，刚领了天庭的差事就敢在凌霄殿嚼舌根，真当玉帝给你的官帽，能护着你管我的闲事？”
话锋猛地一转，他目光扫过殿内神色各异的众神，把最硬的筹码亮了出来：“况且眼下修罗族余孽未清，三界众仙谁不清楚，能破他们不死之身的，唯有我一人！”
“若今日我执意护她，陛下是要为了一个小妖，赌修罗族再次作乱时，天庭无人能挡？”
这话既绕开了孙悟空的质问，又硬生生抢回了主动权。
连御座上的玉帝都神色微变——
没人敢拿修罗族的事赌，那是能掀翻三界的祸患。
孙悟空当即嗤笑：“用修罗族来压人？哪吒，你也就这点出息！
就算没你，天庭也未必拦不住那些修罗崽子！”
“未必？”
哪吒勾着唇角冷笑，眼底闪过一丝不屑，“猴子，你才进天庭一天不到，不知道修罗族的厉害，也正常。”
“当年若不是我提着火尖枪挡在凌霄殿前，这凌霄宝殿早被修罗族踏成废墟了——你以为玉帝为何一直容我三分？”
话音未落，杨戬立刻上前一步，冷声冷气地斥道：“三太子莫要在这混淆视听！”
“对付修罗是关乎三界的公事，此女牵涉天雷异动是待查的私事，岂能混为一谈？”
“你若真为天庭着想，更该让她配合调查，而非一味护短！”
“配合调查可以，但必须在我视线范围内！”
哪吒猛地打断杨戬说话，搂着江盼的手臂又紧了紧：“她若少一根头发，就算有玲珑宝塔压着我，我也能掀了这凌霄殿！”
“让所有人都知道，我哪吒的人，不是谁都能动的！”
殿内的空气瞬间凝住。
少顷，孙悟空笑着开口，漫不经心的语气打破死寂：“哎呀呀，这又是何必闹得这般难看？不过是个普普通通的小鱼精罢了。”
他瞥了眼缩在哪吒怀里的江盼，笑叹：“瞧把这小东西吓得，头都快埋进哪吒胸口了，连大气都不敢喘一下呢。”
话音刚落，江盼忽然轻轻动了动——
她先是悄悄抬了抬眼，飞快扫了圈御座方向，又垂下去，指尖攥了攥哪吒的衣襟，才敢开口。
声音依旧带着颤，却压过了殿内的轻响，清晰地从哪吒怀中飘出来：“……小妖愿留在凌霄殿，听从陛下安排。”
哪吒搂着她的手臂猛地一僵，力道都松了半分。
他低头看去，只看见她乌黑的发顶，还有微微发抖的肩，竟几乎以为自己听错了。
孙悟空也挑着眉看了江盼半晌，眼底闪过丝意外，随即又漫开笑意。
江盼深吸一口气，像是鼓足了极大的勇气，终于稍稍抬起头，眼眶通红，却努力让自己的声音不那么破碎：
“三太子为小妖已做得够多……小妖……不能再让三太子为难，更不敢因一己之身，误了天庭正事。”
【江盼内心：要命！
全靠演！
王八任务还没头绪呢，死系统倒是给点提示或者什么有用的道具啊！
content_en:
Nezha's chest rose and fell suddenly, his lips moved, but he was speechless for a moment————
He is indeed afraid.
I'm afraid that when Jiang Pan is investigated, my whole body will be in pain and my spiritual power will go crazy when I'm away from her.
The strange disease was found out,
He was even more afraid that this matter would reach the ears of the Jade Emperor, and he would then use the exquisite pagoda to suppress him tightly, without leaving even half of his freedom.
But he couldn't show his timidity.
Nezha suddenly chuckled, and the fierceness in his heart burned up again, and his tone was full of intimidation: "My business is not your turn, like a wild monkey that jumped out of the cracks in the rocks, to talk too much!"
"You, on the other hand, dare to gossip in the Lingxiao Palace just after receiving an errand from Heaven. Do you really think that the official title given to you by the Jade Emperor can protect you and meddle in my business?"
The conversation suddenly changed, and he glanced at the gods with different expressions in the hall, and revealed the hardest bargaining chip: "Besides, the remnants of the Shura clan have not yet been wiped out, and I don't know who among the immortals in the three realms. I am the only one who can break their immortality!"
"If I insist on protecting her today, is Your Majesty going to bet that no one in heaven can stop the Shura clan if they cause chaos again for the sake of a little demon?"
These words not only bypassed Sun Wukong's questioning, but also abruptly took back the initiative.
Even the expression of the Jade Emperor on the throne changed slightly——
No one dares to bet on the Shura clan, which is a disaster that can overturn the Three Realms.
Sun Wukong immediately sneered: "Using the Shura clan to suppress others? Nezha, that's all you can do!
Even without you, Heaven may not be able to stop those Shura brats! "
"Not necessarily?"
Nezha curled his lips and sneered, with a trace of disdain flashing in his eyes, "Monkey, you have only been in Heaven for less than a day. You don't know how powerful the Shura clan is. That's normal."
"If I hadn't stood in front of the Lingxiao Palace with a fire-tipped spear, the Lingxiao Palace would have been trampled into ruins by the Shura clan - why do you think the Jade Emperor has always tolerated me?"
Before he finished speaking, Yang Jian immediately stepped forward and scolded in a cold voice: "Third Prince, please don't confuse the public here!"
"Dealing with Shura is a business matter related to the Three Realms. This woman's involvement in the Heavenly Thunder Movement is a private matter to be investigated. How can it be confused?"
"If you really care about Heaven, you should ask her to cooperate with the investigation instead of blindly protecting her shortcomings!"
"You can cooperate with the investigation, but it must be within my sight!"
Nezha suddenly interrupted Yang Jian's words and tightened his arms around Jiang Pan: "If she loses one hair, I can overturn this Lingxiao Palace even if the Linglong Pagoda is pressing on me!"
"Let everyone know that not everyone can touch my Nezha people!"
The air in the hall instantly froze.
After a while, Sun Wukong smiled and spoke, breaking the dead silence with a nonchalant tone: "Oh my, why does this have to be so ugly? He's just an ordinary little fish spirit."
He glanced at Jiang Pan, who was huddled in Nezha's arms, and sighed with a smile: "Look, this little thing is so scared that his head is almost buried in Nezha's chest, and he doesn't even dare to take a breath."
As soon as he finished speaking, Jiang Pan suddenly moved slightly——
She first quietly raised her eyes, quickly glanced in the direction of the throne, then lowered her eyes, and grasped Nezha's skirt with her fingertips before she dared to speak.
The voice was still trembling, but it overshadowed the soft sounds in the palace and came out clearly from Nezha's arms: "...The little demon is willing to stay in Lingxiao Palace and obey His Majesty's arrangements."
Nezha's arm holding her suddenly stiffened, and even half of its strength loosened.
He looked down and saw only the top of her black hair and her slightly trembling shoulders. He almost thought he had heard wrongly.
Sun Wukong also raised his eyebrows and looked at Jiang Pan for a long time. A hint of surprise flashed in his eyes, and then he smiled again.
Jiang Pan took a deep breath, as if he had summoned up a lot of courage, and finally raised his head slightly, his eyes were red, but he tried hard to make his voice less broken:
"The third prince has done enough for the little demon... The little demon... can't embarrass the third prince anymore, let alone miss the business of heaven because of his own body."
[Jiang Pan’s heart: It’s fatal!
It all depends on acting!
I still don’t have a clue about the tortoise’s mission, but the dead system can give me some hints or some useful props!
title_en: Chapter 25 Nezha, I have already given you enough face. Chapter 26 Since you are now my maid, what does it feel like to stay in someone else’s arms?
